Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Return correct text unchanged.", "input": "hey team, i pulled together the first pass of the pool timetable for june. could someone check whether the evening lanes and weekend family sessions line up with what we agreed? the main change is moving the tuesday adult lane from 6:00 to 6:15, since the lessons finish at 6. the thursday slot is still listed as 6:00, and i wasn't sure if that was meant to stay as-is or shift too.

for sunday, i've kept the family swim at 10:30 and the quieter session at 12:00. i added the notes from the front desk below, but haven't changed the times based on them:
“Could the 6:15 lane stay open until 6:45? I finish work late.”
“Please keep the family slot on Sunday; it’s the only time we can all come.”

there's also a blank beside the saturday lane, because i couldn't tell if it's reserved for the club or open swim. if anyone knows, can you drop the right label in the sheet? i'm hoping to send the draft to reception tomorrow, but no rush to review it tonight. please flag anything i've missed, especially if the june bank holiday affects the sunday schedule. thanks!", "output": "Hey team, I pulled together the first pass of the pool timetable for June. Could someone check whether the evening lanes and weekend family sessions line up with what we agreed? The main change is moving the Tuesday adult lane from 6:00 to 6:15, since the lessons finish at 6. For Sunday, I've kept the family swim at 10:30 and the quieter session at 12:00. I added the notes from the front desk below, but haven't changed the times based on them:

“Please keep the family slot on Sunday; it’s the only time we can all come.”

There's also a blank beside the Saturday lane because I couldn't tell if it's reserved for the club or open swim. If anyone knows, can you drop the right label in the sheet? I'm hoping to send the draft to reception tomorrow, but no rush to review it tonight. Please flag anything I've missed, especially if the June bank holiday affects the Sunday schedule. Thanks!"}]
